title: Double Saucy Teriyaki Tofu & Garlic Rice
subtitle: with Cucumber Salad
description: Load up a forkful of tangy and umami tofu, crisp veg and fluffy garlic rich and get ready to enjoy moreish mouthfuls of this veggie delight!

steps.text:
• Finely chop or crush garlic. In a medium saucepan, melt the butter with a dash of olive oil over medium heat.
• Cook garlic until fragrant, 1-2 mins. Add the water (for the rice) and a generous pinch of salt and bring to the boil. Stir in jasmine rice, cover with a lid and reduce heat to low.
• Cook for 10 mins, then remove from heat and keep covered until rice is tender and all water is absorbed, 10 mins.

• Cut Japanese tofu into 2cm chunks.
• Thinly slice cucumber into rounds. Thinly slice spring onion (see ingredients).
• In a small bowl, combine teriyaki seasoning, chilli flakes (if using), the soy sauce, water (for the sauce) and honey.

• When the rice has 5 mins remaining, heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
• Cook tofu, tossing, until browned, 3-4 mins (cook in batches if your pan is getting crowded).
• Reduce heat to medium, stir in teriyaki sauce mixture and cook until bubbling, 1-2 mins. Toss to coat.

• In a medium bowl, combine salad leaves, cucumber and a drizzle of white wine vinegar and olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.
• Divide garlic rice and cucumber salad between bowls.
• Top with saucy teriyaki tofu. Spoon over any remaining glaze from pan. Drizzle with the mayonnaise and garnish with spring onion to serve.
